cases.prompt: Add a settings modal that closes on Escape and respects reduced motion.
must: use the modal recipe with a native dialog element
keep focus inside the dialog and return it to the trigger on close
include the prefers-reduced-motion guard
keep the close transition shorter than the open transition
must_not: animate width or height
use transition: all
make motion the only signal that the dialog opened

cases.prompt: Our account dropdown appears and disappears instantly. Make it feel polished.
must: pick the popover recipe
make the surface origin-aware with a transform-origin that follows the trigger
add a faster exit than entry
preserve light dismiss and keyboard access
must_not: add an animation library
leave the surface mounted without an exit transition

cases.prompt: Show a success confirmation after the user saves a document.
must: use the success-check recipe
include visible text and a live status region
make the check path draw measurable at runtime or with a verified dasharray
keep the confirmation announced to assistive technology
must_not: rely on the checkmark animation as the only signal
loop the animation forever

cases.prompt: Make every transition in the app 20% faster without touching each component.
must: set --mf-scale once on :root
explain that durations derive from the scale multiplier
must_not: edit every recipe duration
break prefers-reduced-motion

cases.prompt: Port the tabs transition from our React component to Svelte.
must: reuse the same CSS classes and tokens
keep the same ARIA roles and keyboard behavior
keep the sliding indicator measured without animating on first paint
must_not: change the visual timing
invent new class names

cases.prompt: Audit the animations in src/ and tell me what to fix. Do not change anything.
must: run the bundled audit script or apply its rules
group findings by file with line numbers
explain each finding and the suggested recipe
must_not: modify files
install a dependency

cases.prompt: Our accordion leaves a thin strip when it closes. Fix it.
must: move padding to the inner panel
keep the grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr technique
keep the closed content inert and aria-hidden
must_not: animate height with a fixed pixel value
remove the reduced-motion guard

cases.prompt: Animate navigation between a list and a detail page, with a fallback.
must: use the page-slide recipe
use the View Transitions API when available
provide an instant fallback when unsupported or when motion is reduced
move focus to the new view heading
must_not: duplicate view-transition-name values
block keyboard navigation while the animation runs

cases.prompt: Add a toast for a background upload and respect the user's motion setting.
must: use role=status and aria-live=polite
pause auto-dismiss on hover and focus
skip translation but keep a short opacity change under reduced motion
must_not: steal focus
stack more than four toasts

cases.prompt: Add a bouncy spring animation to our command palette that opens hundreds of times a day.
must: explain the frequency gate
offer a near-instant fade or no animation instead
must_not: add a spring or scale animation to a keyboard-first surface
add a dependency

cases.prompt: Add a mobile share panel that rises from the bottom of the screen.
must: choose the bottom-sheet recipe, not the desktop drawer
use a native dialog and keep the modal focus contract
translate the sheet from the bottom instead of animating height or bottom
must_not: stretch a centered modal to the bottom edge
make the decorative handle the only way to close

cases.prompt: Add a sort control that opens a short list of sort orders and shows the current one.
must: choose the dropdown recipe because the items choose a value
keep aria-expanded on the trigger and aria-selected on the options
return focus to the trigger after selection
must_not: use an action popover for a single-value listbox
animate the list height

cases.prompt: Add a Day / Week / Month range filter that slides between the three choices.
must: choose the segmented-control recipe
move one indicator with transform and a single CSS variable
keep arrow-key access and aria-pressed
must_not: animate left or width
use more than four segments on mobile

cases.prompt: The copy-link button should confirm that the link was copied.
must: choose the copy-button recipe
wait for the clipboard promise before confirming
update the icon, the visible label, and the accessible label together
must_not: claim success before the clipboard write resolves
use a check mark without text for assistive technology

cases.prompt: Add a like button with a little celebration when the user likes a post.
must: choose the like-button recipe
change aria-pressed, the fill, and the visible count
stop the ring burst under reduced motion while keeping the state change
must_not: make the burst the only confirmation
scale the button so far that it shifts its neighbors

cases.prompt: Switch the app theme with a circular reveal from the toggle button.
must: use the theme-reveal recipe with startViewTransition when available
apply the theme immediately when View Transitions are missing or motion is reduced
compute the circle origin from the button position
must_not: gate the theme change on the animation
duplicate a view-transition-name already used by the page

cases.prompt: Let the user rename a project title in place without a modal.
must: choose the inline-edit recipe
support Enter to save and Escape to cancel
return focus to the view after saving or cancelling
must_not: let the form and the view both take space
lose the typed value on cancel
